name: Data grid
purpose: The interactive data table: sort, filter, row selection and edit-in-place for data-dense fintech screens (transactions, payees, batch approvals). The distinct component the gated Table's rubric decision A anticipated (2026-06-22: 'if a sortable table is ever needed it should be a distinct component') — Table stays the PASSIVE semantic table; the grid owns interaction on the ARIA grid pattern. Peer shapes: Carbon DataTable, Ant Table, AG-Grid.

props.name: columns
props.$note: Column defs: key · label · numeric (right-aligned, .t-cm-figure-5 tabular) · sortable · editable. Sort headers are full-cell buttons riding .t-cm-button (16/500 — Table's header weight via composite).

props.name: selection
props.$note: Leading checkbox column (Selection-controls anatomy); header checkbox = page scope, indeterminate when partial.

props.name: filters
props.$note: Search-committed terms rendered as dismissible chips (Tags recipe, namespaced .fchip); terms AND-combine across text columns.

props.name: pageSize
props.$note: Footer: range read-out · rows-per-page select · pagination (Pagination recipe: 44px targets, aria-current border).

props.name: state
props.$note: loading = aria-busy + Skeleton bones (by reference); empty = message + clear-filters recovery action.

sort-header.use: Full-cell button in columnheader; aria-sort cycles none→ascending→descending; glyphs sort/chevron-up/chevron-down (library). Carries .full — cell-bound, hover grow would overflow (Button's own guard).

selection-checkbox.use: 22×22 box, tick/mixed bespoke control glyphs, checked = secondary/background/default + text/on-inverse (Selection-controls verbatim anatomy; colour states only — form-control precedent).

filter-field.use: Search-field boxed chrome (FIELD-CHROME-COPY — receipted field-family accretion evidence). Enter commits the term as a chip.

applied-chip.use: Dismissible Tags recipe, namespaced .fchip (.tag/.chip are type.css-bound blast radii). Dismiss × = 24px button-family member; Tags' tactile × motion deliberately NOT copied (motion belongs to the partial, B-D7).

edit-cell.use: Reference column; Enter/F2/double-click opens; editing chrome = field ACTIVE recipe (border/active 4px bottom stroke + page fill); Esc cancels, Enter/blur commits; announced.

pagination.use: Prev/next chevrons + page numbers; current = tertiary/border/default + .t-cm-button (500 via composite, not raw weight); inverting colour press (tertiary/background/pressed + text/reverse).

tokens.row-chrome: table/header/background · table/column/background · table/border — consumed from Table unchanged; cells background/default; row hover tertiary/background/hover
tokens.selected-row: form/background/hover tint + 4px inset start bar form/border/active + checked box (never colour alone); distinct semantic source from hover so themes can split them
tokens.field-chrome: form/border/default · form/border/active · form/background/hover (Search-field/Input-fields recipe — accretion evidence)
tokens.type: composites only via markup class — headers .t-cm-button · data .t-cm-label · amounts .t-cm-figure-5 (tabular) · captions .t-cm-caption · editor/search .t-cm-input
tokens.radius: border-radius/control · surface · indicator role tokens (Mono resolves 0; themes flex, ADR-0010)
tokens.$survey: Mined, never modified: Table (visual canon — row chrome, density, weights), Search-field (field chrome, BY COPY — receipted accretion evidence), Tags (chip recipe), Selection-controls (checkbox anatomy), Pagination (footer recipe), Skeleton-loader (bones, by reference), Account-selector (aria-selected idiom), Icon-button/Button (physics geometry + marker protocol).

motion.press: Sort headers, chip dismiss ×, clear-filters, pagination = button-family members; empty AUTO-PARTIAL markers await injection on registration (ADR-0013; $members proposal in the worker receipt). No local press-shaped CSS anywhere.
motion.reducedMotion: Global collapse + static bones; the injected partial carries its own override.

responsive.rule: Horizontal scroll region + sticky header — a DELIBERATE divergence from Table's card-collapse: collapsing to cards orphans the columnheader/aria-sort relationships the grid's AT contract depends on (peer-grid shape). Reflow duty is met by the passive Table; min-width 640px, container width demo-controlled to 320px.

accessibility.semantics: Native <table> + role=grid; aria-rowcount/aria-rowindex track the FILTERED set across pages; columnheaders carry aria-sort; rows carry aria-selected.
accessibility.keyboard: APG grid: ONE tab stop, roving tabindex over cells — arrows move, Home/End row ends, Ctrl+Home/End grid ends; Enter/Space activates the cell's widget (sort · checkbox · edit); F2/double-click edits; Esc cancels. Widgets inside cells are tabindex=-1 so Tab exits the grid.
accessibility.announcements: Visually-hidden role=status (polite) narrates sort, selection counts, filter apply/remove, page, edit commit/cancel; the visible results count is aria-live too.
accessibility.states: Selected = tint + inset bar + checked box (1.4.1); loading = aria-busy + role=status text, bones aria-hidden (decorative); empty offers a real recovery action; focus ring 2px focus/ring, offset -2 (axs-004).
accessibility.editing: Editor is a labelled text input ('Edit reference for <payee>'); commit/cancel announced; grid navigation suspended while editing (keys stay in the editor).

antiPatterns: Bolting sort/selection onto the passive Table (decision A: they are distinct components)
Card-collapse on an interactive grid (orphans columnheader/aria-sort AT relationships)
Sort direction by colour or icon-opacity alone (aria-sort + distinct glyphs here; icons stay full-ink, icon-011)
Selection shown by tint alone (bar + checkbox carry it structurally)
Local press physics on grid controls (button-family partial territory — the ratchet bites)
A second tab stop inside the grid (widgets are reached from cells, not Tab)

tokenValidation.result: PASS expected at build — every bound var resolved from the store this session (retrieval receipted in the worker receipt); contrast pairs declared for text on all three row grounds + reverse-on-pressed + on-inverse glyph + three ui borders/icons.
tokenValidation.$note: Built Phase-2 wave 2 (worker C, Data-grid lane, itinerary row 51). Open: error/validation state awaits the input-error null-slot ruling (A-Q2); density toggle + column show/hide deferred (View-options territory); virtualised rows out of scope for a reference snippet.
